attribution.title: Castillo Serralles
attribution.author: User:Mtmelendez
attribution.description:
Street facade of the Castillo Serrallés — historic mansion, gardens, and present day historic house museum, overlooking Ponce, in southern Puerto Rico.
  • The Spanish Colonial Revival style residence was completed in 1930, and is on the National Register of Historic Places in Ponce, Puerto Rico.

places.name: Local Fishermen Wharf
places.ai_summary: The Local Fishermen Wharf is a great place to observe local fishermen at work and buy fresh seafood directly from the source.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is early morning.

places.place_tip: Bring a cooler if you plan to buy seafood.
places.address: Local Fishermen Wharf, Guánica, Puerto Rico

places.name: Cave Exploration Trail
places.ai_summary: The Cave Exploration Trail is an adventurous hike that leads to fascinating caves with historical petroglyphs.

opening_hours.notes: Wear sturdy shoes and bring a flashlight.

places.place_tip: Visit with a guide for a better experience.
places.address: Cave Exploration Trail, Guánica, Puerto Rico
